# GOSPELS (gospelss.org) — Swedish Non-Profit Ministry Platform

> GOSPELS (Swedish Org.nr: 802557-4883) is an open Christian non-profit organization (ideell förening) based in Gothenburg, Sweden. It organizes 100% free contemporary worship gatherings, youth mentoring programs, Swedish GDPR Article 9-compliant pastoral prayer care, and community outreach.

## Quick Facts
- **Organization Name**: Gospels (ideell förening)
- **Swedish Corporate Identity (Org.nr)**: 802557-4883
- **Headquarters**: Gothenburg, Sweden (Göteborg, Sverige)
- **Primary Domain**: https://gospelss.org
- **Primary Language**: Swedish (sv-SE), with multi-lingual community welcoming
- **Classification**: Category A Non-Profit Ministry Platform
- **Key Slogan**: Helig · Välkomnande · Livsförvandlande (Sacred · Welcoming · Transformative)
- **Admission**: 100% Free Admission for all concerts and gatherings; no forced registration

## Core Initiatives & Services
- **Free Worship Gatherings**: Large-scale open-air and hall concerts (e.g., GOSPELS Live i Göteborg, Trädgårdsföreningen / Stora Teatern) featuring live worship, choir ensembles, and testimonies.
- **Kingdom Partners**: Monthly recurring transparency giving program (150 SEK, 300 SEK, 500 SEK) funding venue rentals, youth transport, and free community admission.
- **Swedish Giving**: Swish (Nummer: `123 456 78 90`), Bankgiro (`5051-1234`), Stripe card payments.
- **Confidential Prayer Care**: 100% confidential prayer request pipeline protected by Swedish GDPR Article 9 explicit spiritual consent. Requests undergo automated pastoral triage via AI Sidekick (powered by Gemini Flash) for urgent pastoral care dispatch. Zero public syndication.
- **Volunteer Program**: Multi-track youth and young adult intake across Hospitality, Sound & Light, Media & Creative, Prayer Team, and Stage Management. Strict youth safeguarding for volunteers under 18 years old requiring verified parent/guardian consent.
